name: Image Aspect Ratio Tagging
description: Adds a decimal field to the image media type that auto-populates with each image's aspect ratio (width/height) on save.
project_description: This module adds a decimal field (field_aspect_ratio) to the core "image" media type that is automatically populated with the aspect ratio (width divided by height) of the underlying image file whenever a media entity is saved. Storing the ratio as data enables faster searching/filtering of images by aspect ratio and lets themes reserve layout space. A batch admin route recalculates the ratio for all existing image media. If there is interest, the maintainers may expand the scope to other bundles and field names. Related: Media Image Metadata.
